# monotaur_maintenance_schedule (Resource)

Manages a recurring Monotaur maintenance schedule. At each occurrence of the cron `schedule` (evaluated in `time_zone_id`) the schedule has a maintenance window lasting `time_span`. The API creates these windows itself, one occurrence ahead, copying the schedule's description, flags and components; they are not managed by Terraform. Deleting the schedule deletes its not-yet-started window and keeps past ones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_component" "database" {
  name = "Database"
}

# Patch the database every Sunday from 02:00 to 04:00 Berlin time. Monotaur
# creates each occurrence's maintenance window itself, one occurrence ahead.
resource "monotaur_maintenance_schedule" "weekly_patching" {
  description               = "Weekly database patching"
  schedule                  = "0 2 * * 0"
  time_span                 = "02:00:00"
  time_zone_id              = "Europe/Berlin"
  exclude_from_downtime     = true
  apply_to_component_status = true
  squelch                   = true
  component_ids             = [monotaur_component.database.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A description of the maintenance (1 to 250 characters), copied to every generated window.
- `schedule` (String) A cron expression for when each window starts: five fields (e.g. `0 2 * * 0` for Sundays at 02:00), six fields with a leading seconds field, or a macro such as `@daily`.
- `time_span` (String) How long each window lasts, as a positive .NET TimeSpan `[d.]hh:mm:ss`, e.g. `02:00:00` or `1.00:00:00` for a day. The API normalises the spelling (`2:0:0` becomes `02:00:00`); an equal duration is not shown as a change.

### Optional

- `apply_to_component_status` (Boolean) Whether the components show as under maintenance while a generated window is active. Defaults to `false`.
- `component_ids` (List of String) IDs of the components the schedule's windows apply to. The upcoming generated window follows changes. Set to `[]` to remove all.
- `exclude_from_downtime` (Boolean) Whether time inside the generated windows is excluded from downtime in uptime reports. Defaults to `false`.
- `squelch` (Boolean) Whether alarm notifications for the components are suppressed while a generated window is active. Defaults to `false`.
- `time_zone_id` (String) The time zone `schedule` is evaluated in, as an IANA ID such as `Europe/Berlin` (Windows IDs are also accepted and stored as written). Unset means UTC.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the schedule was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the maintenance schedule (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the schedule was last updated (assigned by the API).
